page.title: Restaurant
page.description: What guests see at the top of your menu, and how they reach you.

toast.savedDescription: Your menu shows these straight away.

identity.title: Restaurant
identity.description: What guests see at the top of your menu.
identity.nameHint: The heading at the top of your public menu. This is not your own name.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: How guests reach you from your menu.

location.label: Location
location.hint: Paste a link from Google Maps, or use where you are now.
location.noCoordinates: This link has no coordinates in it, so there is no map to show. It still works for guests.

errors.unsupported: This browser cannot share a location.
errors.denied: Location is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser, then try again.
errors.unavailable: Your device could not work out where it is. Paste a map link instead.
errors.timeout: That took too long. Try again, or paste a map link instead.
errors.unknown: We could not get your location. Paste a map link instead.

localisation.title: Money and time
localisation.currencyHint: Changing this relabels existing prices; it does not convert them.
localisation.timezoneHint: Used to work out whether you are open right now.

openingHours.title: Opening hours
openingHours.description: Shown at the top of your menu, and used to say whether you are open right now.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB each.
branding.logoHint: Every menu shows a logo, so this can be replaced but not removed.
branding.coverHint: Cropped to 1920 x 600 and converted to WebP.

validation.uploadUnreadable: That upload could not be read. Please try again.
validation.linkInvalid: Enter a valid link, starting with https://
validation.chooseCountry: Please choose a country from the list.
validation.phoneTooLong: That phone number is too long.
validation.phoneInvalid: Please enter a valid phone number using digits only.
validation.chooseCurrency: Please choose a currency from the list.
validation.nameRequiredInEnglish: The restaurant name is required in English.
validation.nameTooShort: The restaurant name must be at least 2 characters.
validation.nameInvalidChars: The restaurant name contains characters that are not allowed.

features.title: Features
features.description: Switch off what you don't use. Nothing is deleted, and switching it back on brings it all back.

orders.label: Orders
orders.description: Guests add dishes to a cart and send you the order on WhatsApp.
orders.offNote: Guests can't order from your menu while this is off. Orders you already have stay saved.

qr.label: QR Studio
qr.description: Colours, shapes, your logo and a printable table card for your QR code.
qr.offNote: Your plain black QR code stays on the QR code page, ready to download. Your design is kept.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: How guests find your menu and what they do on it.

languages.label: Multiple languages
languages.description: Your menu in English and one more language, with a switch for guests.
languages.offNote: Your menu shows English only. What you wrote in the other language is kept.
languages.secondHint: Changing it keeps what you wrote in the old language.
languages.saveFailed: Could not save your menu languages
